title: Bounded split-topology Production Governance envelope foundation repair

phases.objective: Close the Production Governance bootstrap paradox without making legacy Migration 225 generally executable: introduce a Governance-only successor migration, a separately authorized exact-SHA/plan-hash repair workflow, and a closed runtime/governance readback selector.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue #6628 typed PLAN/APPLY/VERIFY commands and governed migration schema readback
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A missing Governance-owned capability_resolution_envelope_ledger can be repaired only through fixed Migration 1053 after exact Production identity and allowlisted split-topology checks; same-cycle schema plus exact Apply-ledger readback succeeds without marking Migration 225 applied or mutating Runtime DB, providers, deployment, grants, or credentials.
steps: Keep Migration 225 verification-only in generic runtime bootstrap and recovery contracts.
Create Migration 1053 with only the Governance-owned capability_resolution_envelope_ledger CREATE TABLE statement.
Derive the Governance database exclusively from the repository-owned production-runtime target; reject same-database topology and caller-selected database names.
Require exact live Production SHA, Production branch, production_hostinger_autodeploy runtime class, and explicit runtime identity before a plan is executable.
Use the dedicated MYSQL_BOOTSTRAP operator only inside the protected GitHub Production environment; never expand the table-scoped Governance writer with CREATE authority.
Fail closed on partial table shape, incomplete governed migration ledger contract, checksum drift, stale plan hash, or replay.
Require a separate typed Apply comment bound to exact Production SHA and plan_sha256.
After the fixed one-statement DDL, require same-cycle table shape readback, write a canonical 1053 Apply ledger row, then require exact ledger plus schema readback.
Expose governed migration schema readback through a closed runtime|governance role selector without accepting database names or credentials.
assertions: Migration 225 remains allowed only in dry_run/verification-only paths.
Migration 1053 has checksum 21caf065fa700a92b301fb0abf82cc0e34520acbf4b2c913b920b7914c158e46 and exactly one SQL statement.
Migration 1053 contains no platform_runtime_config or admin_platform_endpoint_tools mutation.
The repair never records Migration 225 as applied.
The repair derives governance_database from RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP_TARGETS_JSON and requires it to be separate from runtime database.
Caller-selected SQL, database name, provider operation, deployment, automatic replay, and secret output are forbidden.
Apply requires APPLY_PRODUCTION_GOVERNANCE_FOUNDATION_1053 plus exact current Production SHA and current plan hash.
No Production mutation is executed by this repository patch or its CI.
Critical workflow/operator/change-contract paths are registered exactly in repository control-plane governance.

phases.objective: After merge and governed Production promotion/deployment, run PLAN only, obtain an exact plan hash, and execute APPLY only under a separate operator authorization followed by VERIFY and fresh 1050 readiness.
